§ 01 — The Index

A leader who treats operations as a craft.

Subhabrata Dasgupta is a dynamic, data-driven Program Manager with 8+ years of experience scaling operations and driving cross-functional strategic initiatives in fast-paced EdTech and PropTech environments. Currently managing global operations at BrightCHAMPS as the central coordination layer across US, APAC, GCC, and India markets.

"Strategy is a slide. Operations is what survives the quarter."

Highly proficient in translating data into actionable insights using SQL and Power BI to optimise KPIs and inform executive decisions. Proven ability to bridge product, tech, marketing, and sales teams to deliver high-impact growth programs with speed and precision.

§ 02 — Practice Areas

What I actually do, day to day.

01 — Programs

Strategic execution & program management.

End-to-end program design across product, sales and operations — from charter and OKRs through to instrumentation, governance, and the unglamorous follow-through. Acting as the central coordination node managing dependencies across cross-functional teams to ensure on-time delivery.

02 — Operations

Workflow automation & SOP design.

Building and implementing SOPs and workflow automations — including Zoho Desk and CallHippo integrations — to improve operational efficiency and scale digital support systems across global markets.

03 — Data & Analytics

KPI tracking & dashboards.

Real-time analytics and MIS reporting using SQL and Power BI — monitoring SLAs, FCR, NPS and backlog to generate actionable insights for leadership decisions.

04 — Cross-functional Leadership

Getting product, sales, ops and training to ship the same thing in the same quarter.

Stakeholder alignment across international markets. Structured reviews, accountability frameworks, and operational cadence — fostering cross-functional collaboration and maintaining accountability without direct authority.

05 — Customer Experience

Learner & customer journey excellence.

Driving customer satisfaction, retention impact, and NPS improvement through a structured, data-driven approach to the learner-parent journey — from SLA adherence to first-contact resolution.

06 — Process Excellence

Continuous improvement & Six Sigma thinking.

Certified Six Sigma White Belt. Process re-engineering, operational efficiency frameworks, and SLA adherence structures — taking high ownership of multiple priorities in fast-paced environments.
